method.chroma: Strict magenta candidates use r>=185, b>=170, g<=110, r-g>=120, b-g>=110 and abs(r-b)<=100. Exterior background must be four-neighbour connected to the raw board border. Large dense enclosed strict-magenta regions are treated as backdrop holes; small or elongated enclosed regions are preserved as potential authored details.
method.poseExtraction: Eight largest complete connected foreground components are grouped 4+4 by row and sorted by centroid x. Nearby auxiliary components are attached to the nearest primary pose. This preserves complete death poses that cross raw nominal cell divisions; naive 384x512 cropping is not used.
method.recomposition: Each complete RGBA pose is uniformly resized by one profile-wide factor and placed into an exact 1774x887 4x2 opaque-magenta board. Torso/body-mass landmarks share the target cell centre root; the lower-exclusive physical support is fixed DESIGN_MARGIN_PX above the cell bottom.
method.scale: One shared factor is derived from the idle median target height and clamped by root-relative left/right/top fit constraints for all 40 poses. No per-clip factor or non-uniform anatomy stretch is used.
method.visual: Manual identity/direction/weapon review plus deterministic overlays, root-registered playback GIFs, a 40-pose contact sheet and a dedicated attack pistol-state sheet.

sharedScale.selection: minimum of idle-derived target factor, all-pose root-relative fit limit, and 1.0

clipChecks.chronology: eight distinct running phases form a coherent cycle
draw, aim, fire, recoil, lower and reholster chronology
clipChecks.heldPoseHolsterState: frames 3-7 held pistol with thigh holster appearing empty; frames 1-2 draw transition; frame 8 reholstered

clipChecks.scaleComparisonMethod: death onset frame 1 only; later frames are intentional collapse

manualIdentityReview.reviewBasis: manual review of all six generated boards, high-resolution attack r1/r2 comparison, root-registered playbacks and the 40-pose contact sheet
manualIdentityReview.headsetAndAntenna: 40/40 selected poses retain the compact headset and antenna
manualIdentityReview.darkQuiltedSuit: 40/40 selected poses retain the dark quilted industrial suit
manualIdentityReview.compactBackpackAndCableLoop: 40/40 selected poses retain the compact backpack and protected cable loop
manualIdentityReview.chestAndForearmController: controller hardware remains readable across the selected profile; command emphasizes chest/forearm operation
manualIdentityReview.commandHardwareGestures: 8/8 command poses use deliberate human hand/controller hardware gestures
manualIdentityReview.deathTerminalProne: death frame 8 is a fully prone motionless terminal body
manualIdentityReview.attackR2SinglePistol: best-effort 8/8 manual pass; held poses show one pistol and an empty thigh holster
manualIdentityReview.attackR1Rejected: held firing poses retain an additional holstered pistol, creating duplicated weapon state

rejectedCandidates.reason: attack-r1 firing poses duplicate the sidearm: a pistol is held while a second pistol remains visibly holstered
